configure_data: create a DataConfig with default dataset options and apply it to args to prepare data loaders
make_loaders: build training validation and test data loaders from args with optional TFRecord support
make_data_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader with distributed batch sampling for a given dataset and batch size
make_tfrecord_loaders: load train validation and test datasets from shuffled TFRecords and return them with a tokenizer
get_split: parse a comma or slash separated split string into normalized train validation test proportions
